<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:intro -->
# Public SCIM API reference

This topic provides reference information for Terraform Enterprise's public SCIM 2.0 endpoints under `/scim/v2`. Identity providers such as Okta and Microsoft Entra ID use these endpoints to provision users and groups into Terraform Enterprise.

Authenticate these endpoints with a SCIM provisioning token, not a site admin API token.
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:intro -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:intro -->
# SCIM provisioning API endpoints

This topic provides reference information for HCP Terraform's SCIM 2.0 provisioning endpoints. Identity providers, such as Okta and Microsoft Entra ID, use these endpoints to provision users and groups into HCP Terraform.

Authenticate these endpoints with a SCIM provisioning token, not a user or organization API token.
<!-- END: TFC:only name:intro -->

## Authentication

SCIM provisioning endpoints require a SCIM bearer token in the `Authorization` header:

```http
Authorization: Bearer <SCIM_TOKEN>
```

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:auth -->
Terraform Enterprise returns SCIM responses with the `application/scim+json` content type and accepts JSON request bodies from common identity providers.
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:auth -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:auth -->
HCP Terraform returns SCIM responses with the `application/scim+json` content type and accepts JSON request bodies from common identity providers.
<!-- END: TFC:only name:auth -->

| Status  | Response                | Reason                                                                             |
| ------- | ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [401][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Missing, invalid, expired, or non-SCIM token                                       |
| [403][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | SCIM provisioning is disabled or paused for `/scim/v2/Users` and `/scim/v2/Groups` |

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:link-to-scim-tokens-api -->
Refer to the [SCIM Tokens API](/terraform/enterprise/api-docs/admin/scim-tokens) for provisioning token lifecycle guidance.
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:link-to-scim-tokens-api -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:link-to-scim-tokens-api -->
Refer to [Manage SCIM tokens](/terraform/cloud-docs/scim/manage/tokens) for provisioning token lifecycle guidance.
<!-- END: TFC:only name:link-to-scim-tokens-api -->

## Discovery endpoints

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:discovery -->
Terraform Enterprise exposes the standard SCIM discovery endpoints. These endpoints use the same SCIM bearer token as the provisioning endpoints.

| Endpoint                         | Method | Description                                                                       |
| -------------------------------- | ------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `/scim/v2/ServiceProviderConfig` | `GET`  | Returns the SCIM service provider capabilities supported by Terraform Enterprise. |
| `/scim/v2/Schemas`               | `GET`  | Returns the SCIM schemas supported by Terraform Enterprise.                       |
| `/scim/v2/ResourceTypes`         | `GET`  | Returns the supported SCIM resource types.                                        |
| `/scim/v2/ResourceTypes/User`    | `GET`  | Returns metadata for the SCIM `User` resource type.                               |
| `/scim/v2/ResourceTypes/Group`   | `GET`  | Returns metadata for the SCIM `Group` resource type.                              |
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:discovery -->                              |

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:discovery -->
HCP Terraform exposes the standard SCIM discovery endpoints. These endpoints use the same SCIM bearer token as the provisioning endpoints.

| Endpoint                                                | Method | Description                                                                |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `/scim/v2/:scim_configuration_id/ServiceProviderConfig` | `GET`  | Returns the SCIM service provider capabilities supported by HCP Terraform. |
| `/scim/v2/:scim_configuration_id/Schemas`               | `GET`  | Returns the SCIM schemas supported by HCP Terraform.                       |
| `/scim/v2/:scim_configuration_id/ResourceTypes`         | `GET`  | Returns the supported SCIM resource types.                                 |
| `/scim/v2/:scim_configuration_id/ResourceTypes/User`    | `GET`  | Returns metadata for the SCIM `User` resource type.                        |
| `/scim/v2/:scim_configuration_id/ResourceTypes/Group`   | `GET`  | Returns metadata for the SCIM `Group` resource type.                       |

The `:scim_configuration_id` path parameter is the external ID of your organization's SCIM configuration. This value is provided in the **Base URL** field when you enable SCIM in your organization settings. Refer to [Configure SCIM provisioning](/terraform/cloud-docs/scim/configure) for details.
<!-- END: TFC:only name:discovery -->

| Status  | Response                    | Reason                                                     |
| ------- | --------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| [200][] | SCIM 2.0 discovery document | Successfully returned SCIM discovery metadata              |
| [401][] | SCIM 2.0 error response     | Missing, invalid, expired, or non-SCIM token               |
| [404][] | SCIM 2.0 error response     | Resource type not found for `/ResourceTypes/:name` |

Discovery endpoints authenticate the SCIM bearer token. When SCIM provisioning is paused, these endpoints remain available to callers with a valid SCIM token. If SCIM has been disabled and the provisioning token has been revoked, these endpoints return `401 Unauthorized`.

## Pagination

The list endpoints for users and groups support the following standard SCIM pagination parameters:

| Parameter    | Default | Description                                                                                                                          |
| ------------ | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `startIndex` | `1`     | The first record to return. Values lower than `1` are treated as `1`.                                                                |
| `count`      | `100`   | The maximum number of records to return. <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:count-cap -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:count-cap --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:count-cap -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:count-cap --> caps this value at `200`. Set `count=0` to return only `totalResults`. |

## Supported filters

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:filters -->
Terraform Enterprise supports the following equality filters on public SCIM list endpoints:

| Endpoint          | Supported filters                                 |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `/scim/v2/Users`  | `userName eq "value"`, `externalId eq "value"`    |
| `/scim/v2/Groups` | `displayName eq "value"`, `externalId eq "value"` |
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:filters -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:filters -->
HCP Terraform supports the following equality filters on SCIM list endpoints:

| Endpoint                                 | Supported filters                                 |
| ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `/scim/v2/:scim_configuration_id/Users`  | `userName eq "value"`, `externalId eq "value"`    |
| `/scim/v2/:scim_configuration_id/Groups` | `displayName eq "value"`, `externalId eq "value"` |
<!-- END: TFC:only name:filters -->

Matches for `userName` and `displayName` are case-insensitive. Matches for `externalId` are exact. Unsupported filter expressions return HTTP `400 Bad Request`.

## Rate limiting

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:rate-limit -->
The public `/scim/v2/Users` and `/scim/v2/Groups` endpoints share a default rate limit of 10 requests per second. When you exceed this limit, Terraform Enterprise returns HTTP [429][] with a `Retry-After` header.
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:rate-limit -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:rate-limit -->
The SCIM provisioning endpoints share a default rate limit of 30 requests per second. When you exceed this limit, HCP Terraform returns HTTP [429][] with a `Retry-After` header.
<!-- END: TFC:only name:rate-limit -->

## Request size limits

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:request-size -->
Terraform Enterprise applies a maximum request body size of 1 MB to public SCIM `POST`, `PUT`, and `PATCH` requests on `/scim/v2/Users` and `/scim/v2/Groups`.
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:request-size -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:request-size -->
HCP Terraform applies a maximum request body size of 1 MB to SCIM `POST`, `PUT`, and `PATCH` requests on the Users and Groups endpoints.
<!-- END: TFC:only name:request-size -->

Requests larger than this limit return HTTP [413][] `Payload Too Large`.
